show.description:
Riya joins her dream college but faces humiliation from Aksha and Krish. From clashes in a project, love slowly blossoms, though Aksha’s jealousy creates hurdles. Riya transforms and gains confidence, while Krish realizes his true feelings.
In the end, the two unite in love..
